quests.name: Fish in a Bucket
quests.summary: I'll reward anyone who makes my life a bit easier... I enjoy doing as little as possible, mon!Below the docks here in Shadowprey Village, I've many shellfish traps.  If you're kind enough to do my work and collect me my shellfish, then I'll reward you with something you want... get my drift mon?  For every five shellfish you bring me I will give you a fine Bloodbelly fish!

quests.name: Economic Warfare
quests.summary: One thing that war has taught us: money is power.All centaur in Desolace have come to an agreement to barter with intricately carved wood that shares tales of a centaur's own glory and conquests. It serves as the only reprieve from battle, and only the most level-headed are permitted to engage with other clans.I have seen your kind trade in gold and silver. Worthless to us, as our totems are to you. Bring me some, and the Magram Clan will be pleased.

quests.name: Economic Warfare
quests.summary: Long ago, all of the centaur clans in the Desolace agreed to trade in story. Specifically, carved totems that represent an individual or clan's great accomplishments. Despite the endless conflict, all clans continue to honor this tradition, even if trade opportunities between us have become few and far between.Should you collect any, such as from fallen centaur of other clans, bring them to me. The Gelkis can use more bartering power, and I will inform the Khan of your assistance.
